rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for compliance with rules, laws, requirements, or procedures.

example.english: This shop has maintained compliance with food safety regulations.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭一直遵守食物安全規例。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jat1 zik6 zeon1 sau2 sik6 mat6 on1 cyun4 kwai1 lai6

rows.note: Use this when the compliance specifically means obeying an order or authority rather than following a rule.

example.english: They showed complete compliance with their boss’s orders.
example.traditional: 佢完全服從上司嘅命令。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 fuk6 cung4 soeng6 si1 ge3 ming6 ling6

rows.note: Use this for willingly cooperating with or agreeing to someone’s request or wishes.

example.english: Thanks for your compliance with our arrangements.
example.traditional: 多謝你咁配合我哋嘅安排。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 pui3 hap6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 on1 paai4
